decisions.evidence: There is one short slanted stroke above the word, over the shin/yod. It sits on a middle letter, not the final mem, and looks like qadma (azla). Below the word I see sheva under the kaf and qamats under the bet. No meteg is visible.
Under the nun there is a short vertical stroke just left of the tsere. Meteg: yes.
Under the nun there is qamats with a hooked mark like a '5' to its left. It looks like tevir. Nothing is printed above the word (the upper band is fully visible). No meteg is visible.
Under the second mem there is a small slanted stroke just left of the hireq. It looks like tipcha (tarḥa). Nothing is above the word. No meteg is visible.

Under the he there is a vertical stroke just left of the qamats. Meteg: yes. Above the shin there is a vertical colon over the shin dot, which reads as zaqef qatan with no stroke visible. Only the meteg was asked about.
Under the lamed there is a vertical stroke just left of the pataḥ. Meteg: yes. Under the vav there is a caret-shaped mark next to the qamats, which is etnaḥta.
Above the first ḥet there is a vertical colon between the two lines, separate from the marks under the line above. I see no vertical stroke next to it, so this is zaqef qatan, not gadol.
Above the mem/resh there is a vertical colon and no vertical stroke beside it, so zaqef qatan. The dots further up and to the right are the segol and other marks under the line above.
Above the first ḥet there is a vertical colon over the ḥolam dot and no vertical stroke, so zaqef qatan. Pataḥ is under the final ḥet. No meteg is visible.

remaining_source_ambiguities: Num28:2 nihochi meteg: under the nun there may be a short stroke next to the hireq, but it can't be clearly separated from the hireq at this resolution. Left unresolved; meteg not asserted.
Zaqef qatan vs. gadol (28:2 nihochi, 28:2 tishmeru, 28:6 nichoach): I see no vertical stroke in any of them, but the scan is soft. A faint stroke can't be fully ruled out.
Num28:3 shana: the mark is tevir-like, but the glyph is blurred into a '5' shape. The choice rests on its shape only.
